observableEvidence: claim strength matched to sample / denominator
explicit limits, countercases, or next observation test
evaluationFocus: claim strength matched to evidence base
observation vs inference boundaries; no invented missing cases

fairnessNote: High bar for THIS drill's evidence discipline. Excellent E3 quality may share the 0.85–1.0 band with excellent A1 — engine level/capacity carries difficulty.
